vocabulary.definition: a flap of cartilage at the root of the tongue, which is depressed during swallowing to cover the opening of the windpipe.
vocabulary.example: The doctor explained that the inflammation of his epiglottis was causing difficulty in breathing.

vocabulary.definition: a hereditary condition characterized by improper metabolization of dietary iron that leads to excess iron being absorbed and deposited in various body tissues.
vocabulary.example: The patient was diagnosed with hemochromatosis and required regular bloodletting to manage the iron levels in their body.

vocabulary.definition: the four chief fluids of the body (blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile) on which its health and temperament were thought to depend.
vocabulary.example: According to ancient beliefs, an imbalance in the humors could lead to various health issues.

vocabulary.definition: spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people.
vocabulary.example: The influence of social media is so pervasive that it impacts nearly every aspect of modern life.

vocabulary.definition: the fact of appearing everywhere or of being very common.
vocabulary.example: Due to the ubiquity of smartphones, people can now access information instantly from almost anywhere.

vocabulary.definition: excessively enthusiastic or devoted to a cause or idea.
vocabulary.example: The overzealous fan camped outside the actor's house for days just to catch a glimpse of them.
